_comment: Crew events, mostly driven by individual traits and by how the crew feel about the captain. See docs/events.md.

drunk_on_watch.title: Asleep on watch
drunk_on_watch.text: {drunk} is found snoring at the masthead, an empty bottle in hand. Anything could have come up on you in the dark.

choices.text: A dozen lashes at the grating
choices.result: The crew watch in silence.

choices.text: Stop their rum for a month
choices.result: {drunk} takes it badly, but stays awake.
{drunk} swears off the bottle, and for once means it.
choices.fail_result: {drunk} nods along and is drunk again by the dog watch.

choices.text: Share the next bottle with {drunk}, and say no more about it
choices.result: {drunk} would die for you now. The rest of the watch would rather you didn't drink with the lookouts.

gambling_debt.title: Dice below decks
gambling_debt.text: {gambler} has won a month's wages from {loser} at dice, and {loser} swears the dice were loaded.

choices.result: Loaded, as sure as sin. {gambler} pays it all back.
choices.fail_result: You can't tell. The debt stands, and {loser} thinks you took sides.

choices.result: The dice go over the side. Grumbling for a week.
{loser} pays, and hates you both.

choices.text: Play {gambler} yourself, double or nothing, for {loser}'s debt
choices.result: You win {loser}'s debt back, and {gambler} laughs and shakes your hand. Best night below decks in months.
choices.fail_result: You lose too, and pay both debts. {loser} is grateful, at least.

brawl_below.title: A fight on the berth deck
brawl_below.text: {a} and {b} are at each other with knives over a woman in the last port.

choices.text: Separate them and stop both their grog
choices.result: Your voice alone stops them.
choices.fail_result: Too late: {b} is cut badly before they're pulled apart.

choices.text: Let them settle it with fists on deck, properly
choices.result: {b} wins a fair fight. The matter is closed, and the men enjoyed the show.
choices.fail_result: {a} knocks {b} senseless. Honour is satisfied, more or less.

choices.text: Put {a} ashore at the next port
choices.result: One less hothead.

omen_friday.title: Never on a Friday
omen_friday.text: {sailor} and half the watch refuse to weigh anchor on a Friday. They say a ship that sails on a Friday never comes home.

choices.result: Saturday dawns fair.
They go to the capstan muttering.
choices.fail_result: They go, but they'll blame you for every wave.

choices.text: Look them in the eye, and give the order
choices.result: Nobody says another word about Fridays.

devout_prayers.title: Divine service
devout_prayers.text: {sailor} asks that the ship keep the Sabbath, with prayers on deck.

choices.result: Even the hardest cases take their hats off.
{sailor} prays alone, loudly, for your soul.

popular_birthday.title: A birthday
popular_birthday.text: It's {sailor}'s birthday, and the whole crew loves {sailor}. They ask for a double ration of rum to drink the health of their shipmate.

choices.result: Songs until the middle watch.
Short, but cheerful.
Sour faces.

hated_bullied.title: Bullying
hated_bullied.text: Nobody likes {victim}. Tonight someone cut {victim}'s hammock down in the middle watch, and the lower deck is laughing.

choices.text: Stop it: no man on my ship is a dog
choices.result: It stops. {victim} won't forget it.
choices.fail_result: It stops for a day, then goes on where you can't see.

choices.result: {victim} goes quiet and keeps apart.

choices.text: Pay {victim} off at the next port
choices.result: {victim} goes with a few coins and a grudge.

seasick_hand.title: Green about the gills
seasick_hand.text: {sailor} has been sick for a week and is useless aloft. The others jeer 'landlubber'.

choices.text: Put {sailor} to work in the galley
choices.result: {sailor} is a better cook than sailor.

choices.text: Sea legs come, or the sea takes you
choices.result: A fortnight later {sailor} is racing the topmen.

green_hand_lesson.title: A green hand
green_hand_lesson.text: {green} has never been to sea before and keeps getting in the way. {veteran} offers to show {green} the ropes.

choices.result: Within a month {green} can hand, reef and steer.
{green} learns, with rope burns.

veteran_advice.title: An old hand's advice
veteran_advice.text: {veteran}, who has sailed these waters thirty years, takes you aside: 'Begging your pardon, Captain, but the men are unhappy. Pay, mostly. And the way things are run.'

choices.text: Thank {veteran} and ask what to do
choices.result: The advice is plain sense: pay what's owed and stop the floggings. The men hear you asked.
{veteran} touches a hat brim and says nothing more, and won't warn you again.

ration_thief.title: A thief aboard
ration_thief.text: The purser catches {thief} stealing from the bread room at night. Stealing from shipmates is the worst crime at sea.

choices.result: The crew approve. Thieves get no sympathy.
A pistol, a bottle of water, and a sandbar. Pirate justice.

choices.text: Make {thief} pay it back from their share
choices.result: Lenient. Some think too lenient.
{thief} has been sending the bread ashore to a starving family. You find the money for it instead. Some of the crew think you soft.

schemer_whispers.title: Whispering
schemer_whispers.text: {informant} tells you quietly that {schemer} has been whispering in the forecastle: about your shares, your choices, and who'd make a better captain.

choices.result: {schemer} backs down in front of the crew. For now.
choices.fail_result: {schemer} answers you back, and some of the men laugh.

choices.result: Little by little, {schemer}'s audience drifts away.
choices.fail_result: They take your rum and keep listening to {schemer}.

choices.text: Put {schemer} ashore at the next port
choices.result: {schemer} is gone. Friends left behind remember.
You keep an eye on {schemer}.

family_man_money.title: Money for home
family_man_money.text: {sailor} asks for an advance on their share to send to family in {port}.

choices.result: {sailor} will never forget it.

choices.text: Shares are paid at the end of the voyage
choices.result: {sailor} takes it quietly, but takes it hard.

bloodthirsty_prisoner.title: Sport with the prisoner
bloodthirsty_prisoner.text: {brute} and a few friends have dragged your hostage on deck and are making the poor wretch dance with pistol shots at the feet.

choices.text: Stop it. The man is worth money alive
choices.result: You lock the hostage in your own cabin.
The story will spread.

merciful_objects.title: A matter of conscience
merciful_objects.text: {sailor} comes to you troubled: the crew have been cruel to the prisoners and {sailor} wants no part of it. Several of the men agree.

choices.result: Some grumble, but the decent men are glad.

choices.text: Fear keeps prizes cheap to take
choices.result: {sailor} looks at you as if seeing you for the first time.

navy_drill.title: Gun drill
navy_drill.text: {sailor}, who served in the King's navy, offers to drill the gun crews the navy way: run out, fire, sponge, load, until they can do it asleep.

choices.text: Do it, and use powder for live firing
choices.result: A week of thunder. Your gunner learns a thing or two.
The men hate it, but they're quicker.
The lower deck cheers.

officer_quarrel.title: Officers at odds
officer_quarrel.text: {a} and {b} have quarrelled in front of the men over who gives orders on the quarterdeck.

choices.result: {b} takes the rebuke stiffly.
{a} takes the rebuke stiffly.
They shake hands in your cabin. It may even last.
choices.fail_result: Both leave thinking you a weak captain.

music_night.title: A fiddle on the forecastle
music_night.text: Fair wind, easy sailing. Someone has a fiddle out, and the men are dancing on the forecastle.

choices.result: You dance a hornpipe badly and the men love it.
choices.fail_result: You trip over a ringbolt. Good-natured laughter.

choices.result: The music carries far across the dark water.

extra_rum.title: A tot more
extra_rum.text: The crew send a delegation: hard work, short commons, and they want their rum ration doubled.

choices.result: A happy, if slightly unsteady, ship.
You explain the arithmetic of the hold. They accept it.

shore_leave_demand.title: Shore leave
shore_leave_demand.text: The crew want shore leave, and the back pay you owe them to spend ashore.

choices.text: Pay what you owe and let them go ashore
choices.result: Two days of riot ashore. They come back broke and happy.

choices.text: Promise to pay at the next port
choices.result: They believe you. This time.
choices.fail_result: Three men take their chances ashore and never come back.

choices.text: Promise them Tortuga, and make them believe it
choices.result: By the time you're done they can taste the rum. Nobody asks about the back pay.

fever_aboard.title: Fever
fever_aboard.text: A fever is spreading through the lower deck. {sailor} was the first to fall sick and is raving.

choices.text: Isolate the sick and have the surgeon bleed them
choices.result: The fever burns out in a week. Everyone lives.
choices.fail_result: It burns through the ship. {sailor} and two others are sewn into their hammocks.

choices.text: Make for land and fresh fruit
choices.result: Three days lost and one man buried, but it's stopped.

fall_from_rigging.title: A fall from aloft
fall_from_rigging.text: {sailor} falls from the main yard and lands across a gun. A leg is shattered.

choices.result: It sets clean. {sailor} will walk with a limp, and live.
choices.fail_result: The leg comes off below the knee.

choices.text: Take the leg off now, before it rots
choices.result: Rum, a leather strap to bite, and the saw.

harsh_boatswain.title: A heavy hand
harsh_boatswain.text: Your boatswain {bosun} is free with the rope's end. The men are covered in welts and there's talk.

choices.result: The beatings stop. Discipline slackens, a little.

choices.text: Back {bosun}: a ship runs on discipline
choices.result: The men work faster, and hate faster.

choices.text: Show {bosun} how the Navy does it: by the book, and the book is fair
choices.result: Punishment by the articles, read aloud, the same for everyone. The men grumble less, and fear it more.

loyal_warning.title: A word in your ear
loyal_warning.text: {loyal} knocks on your cabin door after dark. 'Captain, some of the men have been talking about taking the ship. I thought you should know.'

choices.result: {loyal} gives you three. You'll be watching.

choices.text: Pay the men what they're owed, at once
choices.result: Money talks louder than mutineers.

choices.text: Send {loyal} away: you won't run a ship of informers
choices.result: {loyal} leaves, worried.

tattoos.title: Ink
tattoos.text: {sailor} has set up as tattooist on the forecastle. Half the crew want anchors and the ship's name pricked into their arms.

choices.result: The men cheer as the needle goes in.

choices.text: Let them get on with it
choices.result: Every man aboard now carries the {ship} on their skin.

wants_to_leave.title: A man wants to go home
wants_to_leave.text: {sailor} asks to be paid off at {port}. Enough of the sea.

choices.result: {sailor} goes ashore with your blessing.
{sailor} stays, sullen.

choices.text: Pay {sailor} off with a month extra, for the family (40 gold)
choices.result: You know what it is to have someone waiting. {sailor} goes down the side with tears in their eyes.

brave_volunteer.title: A volunteer
brave_volunteer.text: The bilge pump has jammed far down in the dark, where the foul air kills. {brave} volunteers to go down and clear it.

choices.text: Let {brave} go, with a line round the waist
choices.result: {brave} comes up black with filth, and the pump runs again.
choices.fail_result: They haul {brave} up unconscious. Alive, but never the same again.

choices.result: The men won't forget the captain who went down the well in person.
choices.fail_result: You come up half-dead from the bad air.

cowards_hide.title: Found hiding
cowards_hide.text: After the last fight, {coward} was found hiding in the cable tier while the others fought.

choices.text: Put {coward} ashore, no use to anyone
choices.result: Nobody's sorry to see {coward} go.

choices.text: A job where there's no running: the magazine
choices.result: {coward} is good at counting cartridges, at least.

choices.text: Shame {coward} in front of the crew
choices.result: {coward} will never live it down.
